name: lw_29729
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (hx: a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0) (hab : a + b > c) (hbc : b + c > a) (hca : a + c > b) : a / (3 * a - b + c) + b / (3 * b - c + a) + c / (3 * c - a + b) ≥ 1
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (hx: a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0) (hab : a + b > c) (hbc : b + c > a) (hca : a + c > b), a / (3 * a - b + c) + b / (3 * b - c + a) + c / (3 * c - a + b) ≥ 1
informal: Let $a,b,c$ be the side lengths of a triangle. Prove that $\frac{a}{3a-b+c}+\frac{b}{3b-c+a}+\frac{c}{3c-a+b} \geq 1$.
